correctness.rationale: The proof uses exactly the generator structure stated in Theorem 3.2. The \(j=0\) extended Vandermonde block proves independence of every at-most-\(r\) column set. Each full fiber gives a one-dimensional relation of size \(r+1\). For any other putative minimum relation, the \(j=1\) coefficients must be proportional to the unique \(j=0\) relation; since all relation coefficients are nonzero and the source proves the \(d_m\) are distinct, all support points must lie in one fiber. The exact count and repair-set uniqueness follow. The embedded verifier replays a source instance and a higher-locality case and confirms the excluded \(t=1\) boundary.

value.rationale: Minimum recovery sets are intrinsic to the operational purpose of LRCs. The source proves existence of local fiber repair, whereas the new theorem determines the entire minimum repair hypergraph, proves no cross-fiber minimum alternatives exist, and simultaneously gives the exact minimum dual spectrum \(A_{r+1}(C^\perp)=l(q-1)\).
